messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] App got "killed" during overnight run of shinyapp
parts:
That is usually an indication that the instance ran out of RAM.  You will want to bump up the memory size used by the instance.

At some point we will try and capture those errors in a way that is easier for folks to see on the new dashboard we are building.
